commit.subject: LU-14510 tests: skip sanity/130i for 2.16 interop
commit.message:
LU-14510 tests: skip sanity/130i for 2.16 interop

Skip sanity.sh test_130i when running with old MDSes that do
not have FIEMAP support.  The 2.15.63.195 version check landed
in the test was stale, since the patch landed as 2.16.50.12.

Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanity serverversion=2.16 env=ONLY=130,HONOR_EXCEPT=y
Fixes: 5921e1571f ("LU-14510 dom: fiemap support for DoM files")
Signed-off-by: Andreas Dilger <adilger@thelustrecollective.com>
Change-Id: Iedb044b9bd99075c6b1d29148218c33b40f6fc81
